title: Women to begin “memory vigil”: No murdered woman should be forgotten!
content:
The Amed Network Against Violence is launching a “Women’s Justice and Memory Vigil” in response to the recent increase in violence against women, suspicious deaths of women and femicides.




For 10 weeks, women will hold a vigil in front of the Amed Courthouse every Tuesday at 12:30 p.m., where they will read the stories of murdered women and voice their demands for justice. The first vigil will take place on 6 October.




Lawyer Aycan Diril, a member of the Amed Women’s Commission of the Lawyers for Freedom Association (ÖHD), which is part of the network, said that what is happening has gone beyond femicides and become a form of femicide targeting women’s bodies, truths and existence.







 







“Judicial practice has become a male-dominated practice”




Speaking about the purpose and process of the vigil, Aycan Diril said that the killings taking place are not merely numbers and that they aim to create a collective memory in response.




Diril said that data collected by women’s organizations shows an increase in femicides and suspicious deaths of women, adding that the absence of official data is also a significant problem. Pointing out that suspicious deaths of women have outnumbered femicides in data from the past six months, Diril added: “The existence of suspicious deaths of women is, in essence, also a result of ineffective investigations and contributes to the increase in deaths that have been turned into a policy of impunity through these ineffective investigations. The failure of public officials and state institutions to adequately perform their duties, as well as judicial practices having genuinely become male-dominated, demonstrates that justice must come to the forefront as a demand for rights.”




“We want to create a collective memory”




Diril noted that women’s organizations have so far conducted their struggle through press statements and marches, but said they had seen that these methods alone were not sufficient. For this reason, she said, they decided to organize the vigil.




Diril continued: “Every week, we witness the deaths of women who have now become just another number in the news, with only their initials given. Many of these cases are quickly closed as suspicious deaths of women. Women’s names are erased, cases are closed prematurely, and a lasting policy of impunity is implemented. We want to create a collective memory so that women’s names do not disappear, and we want to discuss the stories of these women, the periods during which they experienced violence, and our demands for effective investigations.”




“We want to make women's stories visible”




Diril said they also aim to keep women’s deaths across Turkey, as well as the increasing number of femicides in Amed, on the agenda, adding that the vigil would make women’s life stories visible.




Diril explained that they “decided to hold a vigil where we will share their stories in order to prevent women from being reduced to a number or a statistic. We want to make this issue visible and once again voice our demands loudly, both in society and in terms of state practices. As the women’s struggle grows and women persistently voice their demands, it creates an obstacle to those investigations being left in the dark.”




Diril also said they oppose the rejection of women’s organizations’ requests to participate in trials and want to build broader public support for these demands.




Vigil to be held in front of courthouse every Tuesday




Calling on all women, human rights and legal organizations, and everyone who defends life to join the vigil, Diril said: “We invite all human rights and legal organizations, women, and everyone who defends life to stand up, come together and show their support. We invite everyone to join the vigil in front of the courthouse every Tuesday at 12:30 p.m., where we will share these stories and reiterate our demands for justice.”

title: KNK conference begins: Kurds seek representation and status at the UN
content:
The Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) hosts a conference in Brussels with the aim of securing Kurdish representation at the United Nations (UN) and gaining international status, has begun. Attended by representatives of political parties and organizations from the four parts of Kurdistan and various countries around the world, as well as academics and experts in international law, the conference will discuss diplomatic efforts aimed at ensuring that 60 million Kurds are represented internationally with their own identity and political will.




The conference, held at Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB), is attended by American legal expert Barry Fisher, academic Miloon Kothari, who has worked within the United Nations, and his wife, as well as former Icelandic Foreign Minister Ögmundur Jónasson, and Coni Ledesma, who works in the field of international law.




The conference began with the singing of the Kurdish anthem “Ey Reqîb” and a one-minute silence. This was followed by the election of the conference presidium. Fehmi Vergili, Nilüfer Koç and Wirya Qaradaxi were elected to the presidium.






















Nilüfer Koç: Why don’t Kurds speak in their own name?




Delivering the first speech on behalf of the presidium, Nilüfer Koç drew attention to the fact that Kurds have been left without a name or identity in the international arena for nearly a century. Asking, “Why don’t Kurds, like other nations, speak in their own name?” Koç stated that the main purpose of the conference was to discuss this question and the issue of Kurdish representation at the international level. She said that the identity of 60 million Kurds and their right to representation would be addressed, adding that the KNK has been working intensively on this initiative for nearly a year.




Zeynep Murad: A long-term and strategic mission




KNK Co-Chair Zeynep Murad said that they have been carrying out diplomatic efforts for nearly a year and have held meetings with political parties and organizations in Kurdistan. Stating that these efforts have been conducted by the KNK’s diplomacy group, Murad emphasized that the mission is long-term and strategic in nature.




“Sixty million people live in their own geography with their culture and identity. Yet they have no representation in an international institution. Today, we will hold a discussion on this issue,” she said.






















Karamus: A common national position must be developed




KNK Co-Chair Ahmet Karamus said that the conference marked a historic day for the Kurdish people’s struggle. Stating that the demand for status in all four parts of Kurdistan and representation at the UN has now emerged as a common agenda, Karamus said:




“Today is a historic day in the Kurdish people’s struggle. Today is a day when the issue of the Kurdish people’s status in all four parts has taken shape in people’s minds. All four parts now demand representation and status at the UN.”




Karamus said that serious, sensitive and risky changes are taking place around the world, in the Middle East and across the four parts of Kurdistan, adding that the emerging new process brings both risks and significant opportunities for the Kurdish movement and the future of the Kurdish people.




Emphasizing that successfully advancing this process is essential for the existence, will and struggle of the Kurdish people, Karamus stressed the need to develop unity and a common national position in the face of the threats confronting them. He said that the application process initiated to secure status for the Kurdish people at the UN would contribute to greater Kurdish unity, adding, “Our people must remain united throughout this process.”




Karamus noted that the KNK has so far made intensive efforts toward national unity but has not yet achieved the desired results. He said that, as part of preparations for the UN application, a delegation had been formed to conduct work in different regions in order to assess and discuss the situation on the ground.




He stated that the planned work had been carried out in Rojava, Bakur and Europe, while meetings had also been held in Sulaymaniyah, Qandil and Hewlêr (Erbil).




Karamus stated that meetings with all political parties and sides had yielded positive results, saying: “For the first time, we held meetings and discussions with all political parties and the administration in Bashur (South) Kurdistan. This has generated great hope. In this new process, we now have both the hope and the opportunity to act together and in a coordinated manner. For the first time, the talks were this positive.”




Expressing optimism about unity following the meetings, Karamus said that a strong foundation had been laid for joint action. Stressing that the efforts already initiated would continue, he noted that contacts would be maintained in Bakur, Rojava, Bashur and the diaspora. “We are hopeful. We believe that soon we will be able to share good news and new developments with our people,” Karamus said, adding that despite the differences among Kurds, they had observed a growing awareness, willingness and positive approach toward the issue among the parties they had met with.




At the end of his speech, Ahmet Karamus issued a call to political parties in all four parts of Kurdistan, as well as to organizations and politicians abroad.




UN representation and status on the agenda




During the sessions that will continue throughout the day, the conference will address the legal and political representation of Kurds at the international level, the goal of obtaining observer status at the UN, and the diplomatic initiatives to be pursued toward this objective.




Discussions involving experts, academics, and representatives of political parties and organizations will examine the legal and political dimensions of Kurdish representation in the international arena.




The conference will also discuss how a common Kurdish position can be developed, how the basis for joint action among different political structures and organizations can be strengthened, and the framework within which diplomatic efforts at the UN can be advanced.




The conference continues with presentations by experts in international law and human rights.

title: Vartinis katliamında yaşamını yitirenler anıldı
content:
Muş – Muş Demokratik Kurumlar Platformu, 33 yıl önce Vartinis beldesinde 7'si çocuk 9 kişinin yakılarak katledildiği Vartinis Katliamı'nın yıldönümü dolayısıyla, Vartinis Müzesi'ne doğru yürüyüş gerçekleştirdi. Belde merkezinden müzeye doğru gerçekleşen yürüyüşte Türkçe ve Kürtçe “Em ê komkujîya Vartînîse jibîr nekin û nedin jibîrkirin” pankartı açıldı. Yürüyüşte sık sık alkış ve zılgıtlar eşliğinde "Şehîd namirin" sloganları atılırken, çok sayıda yurttaş katıldı. Yürüyüşün ardından Vartinis Müzesi önünde basın açıklaması gerçekleştirildi.

Katliamda ailesinden 9 kişiyi kaybeden ve şans eseri kurtulan Aysel Öğüt, askerler tarafından ailesinin yakılarak katledildiğini belirtti. Zulüm ve katliamı kabul etmediğini söyleyen Aysel Öğüt, "Ailem ne yaptı? 33 yıldır acısı yüreğimde. Tüm köy halkının yüreğinde. Acımız büyük ve unutulmayacak. Vartînîs'in tarihi olan bir acı. En küçük kardeşim süt emiyordu. Ne yapmış olabilir? Katliamı kabul etmiyorum. İçimdeki acıyı ancak Allah bilir" ifadelerini kullandı.

Ardından konuşan Halkların Eşitlik ve Demokrasi Partisi Muş İl Eş Başkanı İlyas Aslan, yaşanan katliamın Kürt halkında büyük etki yarattığını belirtti. Katliamın yargılamasının gerçeğe rağmen kapatıldığını ifade eden Aslan, "Katliamın zaman aşımı olmaz. Dava bugün AYM’de. AYM’den gerçekten adil bir karar bekliyor ve faillere ceza vermesini istiyoruz. Dersîm, Zilan, Roboskî katliamlarından Vartinis’e kadar hiç bir yargılama gerçekleştirilmedi. Failler cezasız kaldı. Onurlu bir barış için bu katliamların ailelerin talebi dikkate alınarak çözüme kavuşturulmalıdır. Almanya şansölyesi Brant Polonya’da Yahudi Katliamının simge yerlerinden birine giderek burada Yahudi halkından özür dilemişti. Biz de buradan başta Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan olmak üzere tüm hükümet ve devlet yetkililerine sesleniyoruz. Bu halkın taleplerine kulak verilmeli ve bu katliamlar için özür dilenmelidir. Biz bu barışı tüm Türkiye halkları için istiyoruz. Eğer bu acıyı paylaşıyorsak buna dair karşılıklı adımlar atmalıyız. Bu katliamlar bir daha yaşanmasın diye her yıl bu anmaları yapmaya devam edeceğiz" diye konuştu.

Konuşmaların ardından kitle Vartinis Müzesini ziyaret etti. Müzede katliamda yaşamını yitirenler için dua okundu. Okunan duanın ardından müzenin bahçesinde yaşamını yitirenler için saygı duruşuna duruldu. Saygı duruşunda atılan "Şehîd namirin" sloganlarının ardından, anma sona erdi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Pervin Buldan’dan “süreç” açıklaması: “Ekim ayıyla birlikte somut bir gelişmeye tanıklık edebiliriz”
content:
DEM Parti İmralı Heyeti Üyesi Pervin Buldan, Abdullah Öcalan’ın hem silahsızlanma sürecinde hem de siyasal ve demokratik inşa sürecinde koordinatörlük görevini üstleneceğini dile getirdi. Buldan, “Önümüzdeki günlerde bu konuda somut bir gelişmeye tanıklık edebiliriz” dedi.

MA’dan Adnan Bilen’in sorularını yanıtlayan Pervin Buldan, yaptıkları son görüşmede PKK Lideri Öcalan’ın, sürecin ilerlemesi için herkesin inisiyatif alması ve siyasi feraset göstermesi gerektiğinin üzerinde durduğunu aktardı. Buldan, “Süreçte pozitif barış aşamasına geçmemizi sağlayacağını söyledi. Yani yüz yıllık meselenin silahlı kısmıyla değil, siyasal kısmıyla ilgili müzakerelerin olacağı ve adımların atılacağı aşamaya geçeceğiz” dedi.

Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan ve Meclis Başkanı Kurtulmuş’un bugüne kadar sürece pozitif katkı yaptığını belirten Buldan, “Silah bırakma meselesinin sürecin temel başlıklarından biri olduğunu biliyoruz ve bu konudaki hassasiyeti anlıyoruz. Ama bu durumun karşılıklı adımlarla çözülebileceğine inanıyoruz. Burada önemli olan, bu tür söylemlerin sürecin önünde bir ön şart olarak değil, birlikte yürüyen adımların bir parçası olarak ele alınmasıdır” diye konuştu.

Abdullah Öcalan’ın hem silahsızlanma sürecinde hem de siyasal ve demokratik inşa sürecinde koordinatörlük görevini üstleneceğini dile getiren Buldan, şöyle devam etti: “Bunun için kurulan kurulun koordinesini sağlaması, toplumun farklı kesimleriyle görüşmesi, özgür çalışma ve iletişim koşullarının sağlanması kaçınılmaz bir gerekliliktir. Kurul, sürecin ilerlemesinin deyim yerindeyse atar damarı olacak. Kurul hem silahsızlanma süreçlerini yönetecek hem de siyasallaşma sürecinde aktif rol alacak. Bu iki alanın aynı kurul çatısı altında ele alınması, birbirini tamamlayan adımların eşgüdüm içinde atılmasını sağlayacak. Silahsızlanmada atılan her adım siyasal alanı genişletecek; siyasal alanda sağlanan her güvence de silahsızlanma sürecine güven katacak. Bu yönüyle kurulun başarısı, sürecin bütününe duyulan güvenin de teminatı olacaktır. Ekim ayıyla birlikte bu görüşmelerin başlaması ve hukuki güvencelerle sürekliliğinin sağlanması gerekiyor. Önümüzdeki günlerde bu konuda somut bir gelişmeye tanıklık edebiliriz.”

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: DİH okullarda 1 öğün ücretsiz yemek hakkını AYM’ye taşıdı
content:
Demokrasi İçin Hukukçular (DİH), okullarda bir öğün ücretsiz, sağlıklı yemek hakkı için verilen mücadeleyi Anayasa Mahkemesine taşıdı. Sosyal medya hesaplarında yaptıkları açıklamada, “Anayasa Mahkemesinin çocukların eşit-parasız eğitim, maddi ve manevi varlığını geliştirme hakkını önceleyen bir karar vermesini talep etmek hakkımız” ifadeleri kullanıldı.

DİH açıklamasında; kadınların, sendikaların, siyasi partilerin ve meslek örgütlerinin sürdürdüğü mücadele sonucu 2022-2023 eğitim öğretim yılının ikinci yarısından itibaren okul öncesi eğitimdeki öğrencilere uygulanan ücretsiz beslenme uygulamasının 11 Eylül 2023’te Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı (MEB) tarafından kaldırıldığı hatırlatıldı.

Uygulamanın kaldırılması üzerine MEB’e açılan davada Danıştay 8. Dairesinin “devletin mali kaynaklarının yetersizliği, idarenin çocuklara yemek vermekte takdir serbestisi olduğunu” belirttiği dile getirilerek davanın reddedildiği ifade edildi. Bu durumun çocukların üstün yararı, Anayasa ve uluslararası sözleşmeleri göz ardı eden bir karar olduğu belirtilerek 2 Ekim 2026’da Anayasa Mahkemesine başvurulduğu ilan edildi.

Türkiye’de yaşanan fon vurgununa işaret edilen açıklamada, “İktidar temsilcilerinin, çocukların açlığını temel gündem yapması gereken eski Aile Bakanı ve pek çok iktidar elitinin haksız işlemlerle edindiği kişisel servetin, fonculara akan kaynağın ‘çok küçük bir kısmı’ bile çocukların beslenmesini sağlayabilirdi” denildi.

Çocuk açlığını devletin takdir yetkisine bırakan sürecin “Ailem Güvende” operasyonlarıyla da birlikte değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtilerek, “Çocuğun beslenme sorununu çözemeyen aileler güvende değildir, kimlerin ve hangi ailelerin güvende olduğunu ise hep birlikte görmekteyiz” ifadeleri kullandı.

Çocuk açlığına karşı, her çocuğun eğitim hakkına eşit bir biçimde erişebilmek için mücadelenin devam edeceği söylenen açıklamada, “Anayasa Mahkemesinin çocukların eşit-parasız eğitim, maddi ve manevi varlığını geliştirme hakkını önceleyen bir karar vermesini talep etmek hakkımız” denildi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: [Lecture] La rafle du Vél'd'Hiv, Maurice Rajsfus
content:
Loin d'être la seule, la rafle du Vél' d'Hiv reste la plus importante et la plus emblématique des opérations antijuives menées par la police française, «

 

corps de fonctionnaires ayant perdu ses repères

 

», pendant l'occupation nazie. Maurice Rajsfus, fin connaisseur des archives de cette période, analyse tous les aspects de cet évènement, dans l'espoir «

 

d'alerter les citoyens d'un pays libre sur les dérives des pouvoirs forts

 

».




Il rappelle tout d'abord rapidement la tradition xénophobe française, le premier statut des Juifs de France, dès 1937, par Louis Darquier, dit de Pellepoix, les décrets-lois Daladier, l'année suivante, qui permirent l'assignation à résidence des étrangers en situation irrégulière, puis l'internement dans des camps de concentration des «

 

débris des armées républicaines espagnoles

 

», celui des ressortissants allemands résidant en France, à partir d'octobre 1939, essentiellement des antifascistes et des Juifs, qui seront d'ailleurs livrés au nazis l'année suivante.




«

 

 Bien avant que l'Allemagne nazie, qui occupe les trois cinquièmes de la France, ne dicte sa loi au gouvernement de la zone dite libre, Pétain et ses ministres se préoccupent déjà de réprimer les étrangers, “cause des malheurs“ du pays et, plus directement, les Juifs

.

 

» À partir de juillet 1940, différentes lois écartent les juifs de certaines professions, médicales, judiciaires, puis commerciales et industrielles un peu plus tard.

 Le 3 octobre le premier statut des juifs de France est édicté, «

 

 selon des critères plus drastiques que ceux des nazis

 

». 


Le 14 mai 1941, 6000 juifs étrangers de Paris sont convoqués au commissariat de leur quartier et les 3800 qui vont se présenter sont envoyés et internés dans deux camps du Loiret. Maurice Rajsfus illustre ces événements avec des extraits de circulaires officielles et des articles de presse, notamment d'extrême-droite. 


Puis le 20 août, une rafle limitée au 11

e

 arrondissement, est décidée par les Autorités allemandes, pour tester «

 

la bonne volonté des cadres comme de la base policière

 

».


L'organisation des services de renseignements (en particulier la constitution du fichier juif à la préfecture de police, sous la responsabilité de l'inspecteur André Tulard), de police et de gendarmerie, est présentée, ainsi que leur synergie avec les services allemands. À la fin du mois d'avril 1942, avec le retour de Pierre Laval à la tête du gouvernement de Vichy, René Bousquet accède an poste de secrétaire général de la police.




La préparation de la rafle du Vél' d'Hiv proprement dite, est ensuite exposée en détail. Ainsi, une note adressée le 6 juillet par le 

SS

 Dannecker à Adolf Eichmann, suite à sa rencontre avec René Bousquet, révèle que «

 

 le président Laval a proposé que, lors de l'évacuation des familles juives de zone non occupée les enfants de moins de seize ans soient emmenés eux aussi 

 

». Le compte rendu du conseil des ministres du 10 juillet confirme que «

 

 dans un souci d'humanité, le chef du gouvernement a obtenu – contrairement aux premières propositions allemandes – que les enfants, y compris ceux de 16 ans, soient autorisés à accompagner leurs parents 

 

».




Maurice Rajsfus évoque également des «

 

fuites

 

» venant «

 

de trop rares fonctionnaires de police 

 

» permettant à un certain nombre de familles de se cacher. De son côté, l'Union générale des Israélites de France (

UGIF

) et d'autres institutions, informées de la date approximative de la rafle, n'ont aucune volonté de prévenir. Au contraire, l'organisation Solidarité, des communistes juifs immigrés, diffusent un trac très bien informé, avertissant de la «

 

rafle monstre

 

» qui n'épargnera ni les femmes ni les enfants. Par ailleurs, des rumeurs et des fausses nouvelles sont aussi propagées presque quotidiennement.




Il décrit ensuite avec la plus grande précision le déroulement des opérations, depuis le décompte des effectifs de fonctionnaires mobilisés, des interpellations heure par heure, des tentatives de suicide, des accouchements, etc. De très nombreux témoignages sont aussi rapportés. Puis les conditions abominables de détention au Vélodrome d'Hiver sont longuement détaillées : eau coupée, odeur pestilentielle, mares de déjections, fausses couches, cas de folies, tentatives de suicides, la trentaine de morts dont plusieurs enfants. Quelques évasions réussissent. Les rapports des évacuations vers les camps de Drancy, Phitiviers et Beaune-la-Rolande sont également commentés. Des consignes strictes ont été données aux journaux car la presse passe sous silence ces évènements dans les premiers jours. Des allusions dans les publications les plus antisémites n'apparaissent qu'une semaine plus tard et se précisent fin août seulement. La presse clandestine reste laconique sur le sujet.


L'Église catholique, en la personne d'un cardinal, se fend d'une discrète lettre de «

 

protestation en faveur des droits imprescriptibles de la personne humaine

 

», adressée au Maréchal Pétain. Seuls, l'archevêque de Toulouse et l'évêque de Montauban interviennent publiquement, en des termes plus vigoureux. La Semaine religieuse, publication du diocèse d'Évreux, explique la nécessité des mesures de répression raciale en citant l'exemple du pape Paul 

IV

 qui, au 

XVI

e

 siècle, avait pris des mesures contre les Juifs. La réaction des protestants est plus nette bien que tardive.




S'en tenant strictement aux faits, Maurice Rajsfus livre une histoire de la rafle du Vél' d'Hiv, mettant en lumière le rôle d'une police française majoritairement docile et servile.




Ernest London


Le bibliothécaire-armurier




LA

 

RAFLE

 

DU

 VÉL'D'

HIV


Maurice Rajsfus


154 pages – 10,90 euros


Éditions du Détour – Bordeaux – Juin 2021

https://bibliothequefahrenheit.blogspot.com/2021/05/la-police-de-vichy.html

author: Unknown
title: İbrahim Gündem’in kız kardeşi: Kemiklerine kavuşmadan ölmek istemiyorum
content:
Cumartesi Anneleri/İnsanları, gözaltında zorla kaybedilen yakınlarının akıbetinin açıklanması ve sorumluların yargılanması talebiyle Galatasaray Meydanı’nda 1123’üncü kez bir araya geldi.




Hak savunucularının da katıldığı buluşmada gözaltında kaybedilen ve öldürülenlerin fotoğrafları ile karanfiller taşındı.




Bu haftaki açıklamada, 25 Eylül 1991’de Diyarbakır’ın Hazro ilçesinde askerler tarafından evinden alınan ve bir daha kendisinden haber alınamayan İbrahim Gündem’in dosyası hatırlatıldı.




Basın açıklamasını İnsan Hakları Derneği (İHD) Merkez Yürütme Kurulu üyesi Gülseren Yoleri okudu.







Fotoğraf: Mezopotamya Ajansı







İbrahim Gündem’e ne oldu?




Yoleri, 39 yaşındaki İbrahim Gündem’in Hazro’ya bağlı Sarıerik (Qenderhel) köyünde ailesiyle çiftçilik ve hayvancılık yaptığını anlattı.




Açıklamaya göre, 25 Eylül 1991 gecesi saat 01.00 sıralarında Üsteğmen Kenan Şahin komutasındaki askerler Gündem’in evine baskın yaptı.




Gündem, ailesinin ve köylülerin gözü önünde gözaltına alınarak götürüldü. Müdahale etmek isteyen babasına, oğlunun ertesi gün serbest bırakılacağı söylendi.




Ancak aile ertesi gün karakola gittiğinde, Gündem’in gözaltına alınmadığı yanıtını aldı.




Yoleri, İbrahim Gündem dosyasının aradan geçen 35 yıla rağmen etkin biçimde soruşturulmadığını söyledi.







35 Yıldır Soruyoruz: İbrahim Gündem Nerede? 

https://t.co/MhfiJN9QwG


— Cumartesi Anneleri (@CmrtesiAnneleri) 

October 3, 2026




Ailenin başvuruları sonuçsuz kaldı




Gündem ailesi, İbrahim Gündem’in akıbetini öğrenmek için önce Hazro Cumhuriyet Savcılığı’na başvurdu.




Yoleri’nin aktardığına göre savcılık aileyi karakola yönlendirdi, karakola verilen dilekçelere ise yanıt verilmedi.




Baba Ahmet Gündem daha sonra Diyarbakır Valiliği’ne başvurdu. Valiliğin girişiminin ardından karakoldan yine “Biz almadık” yanıtı geldi.




Ahmet Gündem, İl Jandarma Alay Komutanlığı’na yaptığı başvuruda ise “Devleti suçluyorsun, devlet böyle şeyler yapmaz” denilerek azarlandı ve tehdit edildi.




Yoleri, ailenin baskı ve tehditler altında sürdürdüğü arayıştan sonuç alamadığını belirtti.




“Adaleti sağlamak devletin görevidir”




Açıklamada Gündem ailesinin üzerindeki baskıların sonraki yıllarda da sürdüğü ifade edildi.




15 Şubat 1993’te evlerinin askerler ve korucular tarafından yakılmasının ardından ailenin Diyarbakır’a göç etmek zorunda kaldığı belirtildi.




Yoleri, İbrahim Gündem’i aramaktan vazgeçmeyen anne ve babasının, oğullarının akıbetini öğrenemeden yaşamlarını yitirdiğini söyledi.




Şöyle devam etti:







Gündem Ailesi’nin 35 yıldır adalete ulaşamamasının nedeni, devletin etkin bir soruşturma yürütmemesidir. İbrahim Gündem’in akıbetini ortaya çıkarmak, sorumluları belirlemek ve adaleti sağlamak devletin görevidir.







“Kaybeden devletti, nasıl götürdüyse, öyle geri getirsin”




Buluşmada İHD üyesi Ümmühan Kaya, İbrahim Gündem’in kız kardeşi Feride Gündem’in gönderdiği mesajı da okudu.




Feride Gündem, anne ve babasının yaşamları boyunca oğullarından bir haber beklediğini belirterek şöyle dedi:




"Annemin ve babamın bıraktığı yerden ağabeyimi arıyoruz. Her Cumartesi saat 12.00’de Koşuyolu Parkı’nda ağabeyimin fotoğrafını taşıyoruz. Abim İbrahim’in kaybolduğu günden bugüne bir gün dahi huzur bulamadık."




Gündem, ağabeyinin kalıntılarına ulaşmak istediğini söyleyerek şöyle devam etti:







Ben de onun kemiklerine kavuşmadan ölmek istemiyorum. Bu hayattaki tek dileğim bu. Başka bir şey istemiyorum. 35 yıldır ağabeyimi arıyoruz. Onu alıp götüren, kaybeden devletti. Nasıl götürdüyse, öyle geri getirsin.







Ailenin mücadeleyi sürdüreceğini vurgulayan Gündem, “Biz bu davayı bırakmayacağız. Annem ve babam kardeşimi bulamadan yaşamlarını yitirdiler. Biz de onların izindeyiz. Ağabeyimi bulana, mezarına kavuşana kadar mücadelemizden vazgeçmeyeceğiz” dedi.




Buluşma, karanfillerin Galatasaray Meydanı’na bırakılmasıyla sona erdi.




(NÖ)

author: Mada Masr
title: Unconfirmed report asserts official detention order issued for Matsda2sh team amid security leaks, media accusations
content:
A report that emerged on Friday night has claimed that the Supreme State Security Prosecution issued a formal detention order on Thursday for the six journalists from the Matsda2sh editorial team who were arrested earlier in the week.  




The Al-Masry Al-Youm report described the issuance as ordering the journalists’ detention for 15 days.




But as no official announcement has been published by prosecuting authorities, lawyers and a Journalists Syndicate source speaking to Mada Masr cast doubt on the veracity of the news report’s claim, which represents the first indication of an official detention order since the journalists’ arrests. 




Security forces arrested and forcibly disappeared the six members of the Matsda2sh editorial team in the span of 24 hours in a campaign that was launched Monday night. No official statement on the arrest was published until Thursday.




None of the journalists have been presented formally before prosecuting authorities, EIPR lawyers told Mada Masr, and neither their families nor the Journalists Syndicate have been informed of their place of detention, the syndicate source confirmed. 




The Al-Masry Al-Youm 

report

 was back-dated to October 1, but was not available to readers until late on October 2.

 The report stated that a 15-day detention order had been issued for the six journalists following the Interior Ministry’s Thursday announcement of their arrest. The newspaper’s report had not been shared on the privately owned newspaper’s social media channels at the time of writing. 




It cited unnamed “security sources” to describe ongoing investigations into the independent fact-checking platform. 




Islam Salama, a lawyer for the Egyptian Initiative for Personal Rights, which is legally representing the journalists, said that there is no case number indicated in the news. Commenting on its publication to Mada Masr, Salama added that the charges for which the six journalists are being investigated are not described in the privately owned newspaper, which instead echoed claims that the fact-checking platform’s founder is a member of the Muslim Brotherhood.




Salama added that what is described in the report goes no further than reproducing claims that were already circulating on social media in the preceding days. 




A Journalists Syndicate source, meanwhile, said that the way the news is written suggests it to have been a “backdoor leak” amid security agencies’ efforts to escalate against the detained newsroom.




Salama and Nasser Amin, the director of the Arab Center for Independence of the Judiciary and the Legal Profession, said it that a prosecution decision of the kind described in the news report could give authorization to investigating authorities under the counterterrorism law to detain the journalists for up to 30 days in order to continue inquiries without needing to present them before the prosecution. 




Claims against the journalists have escalated in the domestic media over recent days, which has since Friday sustained an accusatory tone linking them to the Muslim Brotherhood. 




Mohamed al-Baz, the editor in chief of Al-Dostour newspaper, which belongs to the United Media Services conglomerate, 

sought

 on Friday to incriminate Matsda2sh, describing it as a “Brotherhood cell” and its journalistic work as “skeptical content that contributes to the spread of rumors.”




In a Friday phone 

interview

 with anchor Amr Adib, former senator and media mogul Abdel Rahim Ali, who is close to state authorities, repeated the same accusations, sharing voice recordings whose provenance he did not disclose and claiming that they belonged to Matsda2sh founder Abdel Rahman Mansour and constitute proof of his ties to the Muslim Brotherhood.

 




“The question has existed for eight years,” said Adib on his MBC Masr show, Al-Hekaya. 

“So why has it become a problem now?,” he asked Ali, who responded that Matsda2sh inflicts “harm on the country’s reputation,” and added that “anyone who is not 

severe

 [to the platform] is committing the crime of high treason, as when the country is ruined, it is the security authorities who will be held to account.”




MENA, the official state platform, and the government-owned Al-Ahram newspaper also published pictures of Matsda2sh’s founder, accusing him of belonging to the Muslim Brotherhood and pointing to his father as a “Brotherhood member who was previously arrested.”




At the same time, calls for the journalists’ release have escalated over recent days. 

Members of the United States’ Congress in the Egypt Human Rights Caucus 

urged

 the Egyptian government to “immediately and unconditionally release” the journalists and to end its “escalating crackdown on independent media” on Friday, in a call that was 

echoed

 by members of the US Senate.




Members of the European Parliament 

expressed

 concern about the arrests and the fact that the journalists “have been denied the right to contact their families and their legal representation.”

 They called on judicial authorities to adhere to due process and be proactive in communicating information to the journalists’ legal counsel and their families.




Over 50 organizations inside and outside Egypt, meanwhile, signed a 

statement

 calling on authorities to release the six journalists immediately and “to halt any and all targeting directed at the [Matsda2sh] platform and to release all journalists detained or imprisoned for their work in Egypt.”

 




Commenting on the report regarding the journalists’ detention order and on the media campaign against the journalists, Amin pointed to a high degree of tension and public concern at present, especially as economic conditions worsen, telling Mada Masr that the arrest of the Matsda2sh journalists has provided “a golden opportunity” for certain security agencies to revive the “Muslim Brotherhood bogeyman” narrative and the specter of a looming external threat to national security. 




While authorities are able to establish control over the small 

protests

 that have taken place in some locales, the lawyer said, it is more complicated to control a media outlet like Matsda2sh, given it belies an ongoing narrative.

 




What happened to Matsda2sh, said Amin, is effectively a warning to others in the lead-up to the Egypt Forum 2026, a state event set to take place this month to review the government’s achievements and provide a forum for public engagement with policy. The warning, Amin said, is that the state will not permit a sense of skepticism about its achievements, nor will it permit platforms like Matsda2sh to tell people not to believe in them. 




It took the Interior Ministry over 48 hours since it initiated the campaign to announce its arrests of the Matsd2sh journalists — Abdallah Qadry, Mohamed Ashraf Abu Emaira, Islam Barakat, Mohamed Mahmoud, Mohamed Adel and Omar Helal. 




Lawyers representing the six proceeded directly to the headquarters of the Supreme State Security Prosecution upon the ministry’s announcement and submitted notifications to the prosecution to ensure they could attend interrogation sessions with the newsroom. 




But the journalists had not been formally brought before the prosecution until the time of publishing, the lawyers said. 

The post 

Unconfirmed report asserts official detention order issued for Matsda2sh team amid security leaks, media accusations

 first appeared on 

Mada Masr

.

author: Unknown
title: Vê hefteyê di biamag kurdiyê de
content:
biamaga kurdî ya vê hefteyê bi edîtoriya Aren Yıldırım û Ferhat Yaşar hat amadekirin. 




biamaga kurdî di vê hefteya xwe de cih dide xebat û lêkolînên li ser mijarên weke wêje, muzîk, serpêhatî, huner, helbest, zanist, ziman, tenduristî û wêjeyê.



















Rûpelek nû ji bo bianet kurdiyê: biamag kurdî




5 Îlon 2026










Ev naveroka berfireh a ku vê hefteyê tê pêşkêşkirin, bi analîzên di qadên wêje, ziman, huner û muzîkê de hewl dide ku valahiya di vê qadê de ji bo xwêneran tijî bike. biamaga kurdî bi tevlêkirina nivîsên di warê zanist û tenduristiyê de, çarçoveya xwe ya weşanê ji sînorên rojeva siyasî derbas dike û ber bi hilberîna zanîna piralî ve dibe.




Naverokên vê hefteyê weha ne:




Sinem Aydinli

 di vê nivîsê de behsa çîroka xwe ya hînbûna kurdî dike û vê yekê di çarçoveya berpirsiyariya etîk û zextên siyasî û dîrokî yên li ser ziman de dinirxîne.




Samî Tan

 di nivîsa xwe de balê dikişîne ser daxwaza Kurdan a ji bo perwerdehiya bi zimanê dayikê. Her weha Tan modela waneyên vebijêrkî ya dewletê weke çareserî nabîne û weke polîtîkaya pişaftinê dinirxîne. "Modela Perwerdehiya Pirzimanî ya li ser Bingeha Zimanê Zikmakî" weke çareserî pêşniyar dike.




Dilşah Kaymaz

 bi analîz û rexneyeke kûr a sosyo-ekonomîk û çandî balê dikişîne ser bandora kapîtalîzma platformên dîjîtal û zextên algorîtmayan a li ser muzîka bi zimanê kêmneteweyan/bindestan.




Eser Çetin

 vê hefteyê jî li ser tenduristiyê nivîsiye. Bi zimanekî sade û fêmbar behsa apandîsitê kiriye. Çetin di nivîsê de hem têgehên bijîşkî radigihîne hem jî bi mînakên ji ziman û jiyana rojane mijarê şênber dike.




Berîvan Kayî 

di nivîsa xwe de tecrûbeyeke vegantiyê û çîroka jiyanê ya aktivîsteke laz bi hev ve girê dide û behsa hevdîtina kampa veganan li Westana Wanê dike.




Mazhar Rojava

 di nivîsa xwe ya bi navê “Nivîsîn: Karê yezdan û sihêrbazan” de bi zimanekî wêjeyî û hestiyar behsa têkiliya xwe ya kûr û tevlihev a bi nivîsandinê re dike.




Ayşenur Ozelê 

di nivîsa xwe ya vê hefteyê de geşedaneke girîng a fîzîk û teknolojiya quantûmî aniye pêşberî xwendevanan. 




Mehmet Erbeyi

 bi zimanekî xweş, herêmî, resen û bi şêwazekî mizahî û xwerû behsa serhatiya xwe ya tal û bi êş a çûna cem dixtorê diran kiriye.




Dilşêr Bêwar

 bi rêya metafor, hêmanên xwezayê, helbestiyeta ziman û hestên kûr ên aîdiyetê, behsa rastiya jiyanê dike.




Siya Robîn

 di vê nivîsa xwe de nirxandina berhema helbestvan Lal Laleş a bi navê 

“Talibên Eşqê”

 dike.







Pêşniyara guhdarkirinê ya vê hefteyê

author: groundxero
title: A Tale of Irony: The Sijimali Story from Odisha
content:
Vedanta’s Sijimali bauxite mining project has thrown Odisha’s Rayagada and Kalahandi districts into the eye of a storm. The predominantly tribal communities living in the villages at the foothills of Sijimali are opposing the project and the State has come down heavily on them. 




 




Dr. Sankalpa Satapathy




 




Vedanta Limited’s Sijimali bauxite mining project aimed at supplying bauxite to the Lanjigarh refinery has thrown Odisha’s Rayagada and Kalahandi districts into the eye of a storm. The predominantly tribal, Kui speaking Kondh and Paraja communities have strongly opposed the project and the State has come down heavily on them. The violent clashes between the villagers and police personnel on April 7, 2026 were only the tip of the iceberg. The resistance has been ongoing for years now.




 




For the people living in the villages at the foothills of Sijimali, the mountain range, the forests, the streams are not just resources to be used but an integral part of their lives, an ecosystem that pervades every aspect of their lives. The dense deciduous forests along with non-timber produce, traditional ancestral lands, non-human dwellers and the watershed that these forested mountain range harbour, sustain traditional livelihoods and support the local economy. During lean agricultural seasons, families survive on wild food such as tubers, roots, fruits etc. They rely on deep traditional ecological knowledge built over centuries and transmitted through generations in orally codified forms which emphasize sustainable use rather than exploitation to maintain ecological balance. Indigenous community driven techniques and practices harvest, store, and manage rainwater and groundwater, protect trees, soil, and wildlife and use medicinal herbs, roots, leaves and barks for treatment of illnesses. They are culturally and traditionally deeply linked to these forests believing that their deity “Tij Raja” resides in the mountains. They get everything from the mountains and do not buy anything from outside adhering to Gandhi’s concept of self-sufficiency, Swadeshi and Gram Swaraj which focused on village independence, local production and simple living.




 




Beneath these forests lies an estimated reserve of 311 million tonnes of bauxite which is fundamental for the smooth running of the Vedanta Lanjigarh refinery to drive 

“growth and development of the region”

. To reach the bauxite, the communities have to be displaced, the forests have to be felled and the mountains have to be dug in a large open cast mine. In short, the entire ecosystem has to be disrupted and destroyed. Felling forests in the mountain range leads to washing off of the rich top soil which is held together by the tree roots. These forests “catch” rain and refill underground aquifers, elevating water tables and nourishing local streams. Losing forests reduces local humidity and rain making the region hotter and drier.




 




The soil erosion, disruption of the local water cycle, destruction of natural wind and dust barriers turn fertile land dry and barren, leading to desertification. Ironically, India has ratified major UN environmental treaties like the UN Convention to Combat Desertification in 1996 and the Paris Agreement in 2016. After data confirmed that July 2023 was the hottest in recorded human history, the Secretary General of the United Nations, Antonio Guterres declared that “the era of global warming has ended, the era of global boiling has arrived”. It was in the same year 2023 that the auction of bauxite mining lease for Sijimali by the government of Odisha was won by Vedanta Ltd which as explained before, if comes to fruition will lead to desertification and add to the already soaring summer temperatures in Odisha.




 




Both the districts, Rayagada and Kalahandi, are designated as Scheduled Areas and fall under the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution which exists to protect indigenous tribal communities, preserve their unique culture, and prevent their economic exploitation. A Tribes Advisory Council (TAC) with mostly tribal members is mandatorily set up to advice on tribal welfare in these areas. This raises the question that if all necessary legislative procedures were followed why are the tribals up in arms in dissent against the state and why is there a military buildup in the areas? Why are there allegations from the tribals that the signatures on the Gram Sabha documents are in English whereas the people of the region write in Odia or give thumb prints? How can the signatures of people who are dead or had migrated for work during the Gram Sabha be explained?




 




The Fifth Schedule of the Constitution provides special powers to the President and state Governors to protect tribal lands, culture and local governance. Yet, in a cruel twist of fate, the people from the protesting tribal and Dalit communities have been violently manhandled and jailed despite the fact that both, the Honorable President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu and the Honorable Chief Minister of Odisha, Shri Mohan Charan Majhi hail from tribal communities themselves. As ancestral adivasi territories are brokered away to corporate, the adivasis are desperate for them to break their silence. What could be more ironic than tribals being arrested for demanding their rights to a life of dignity on Birsa Munda Day marking the birth anniversary of the iconic tribal freedom fighter Bhagwan Birsa Munda which is officially celebrated as Janjatiya Gaurav Divas (Tribal Pride Day). Their agricultural tools such as axes, sickle and hoes are registered as deadly weapons by the police while they are being lathi-charged, tear gassed and non-bailable warrants are being brazenly executed.




 




The criminalization of the protest and the gross and flagrant violation of human rights is taking a harsh toll on the health of the people. In addition to existing health conditions such as malaria, sickle cell anemia, undernutrition, and the protestors have sustained severe injuries. The days spent in protests and jails is adding to woes of missed work days compromising their already pinched incomes, loss of school days impairing education, along with mental distress and anguish that they endure from the police personnel’s vulgar behavior. The militarization of the areas and the constant drone surveillance intrude privacy and severely affect women’s bath and sanitation schedules. The coercive tactics of the corporate-state nexus are also affecting the social fabric by planting the seeds of distrust among the people. They are constantly under stress about their futures which are intimately linked to the forests and mountains and their daily lives have been filled with agitations and consultations to protect the mountain range. The mining activities will affect their socio-economic and health status negatively. The fly-ash will pollute the air, water and soil affecting their health and economies. The warning is stark in neighbouring Koraput district where residents of villages located at the foothills of the Kodingamali region, including Talakaipadar under Odiapentha Gram Panchayat in Laxmipur Block have raised concerns over the discharge of red-coloured water flowing through their village, which they attribute to bauxite mining activities in the area.




 




Yet, they refuse to give up. In the words of Gobinda Naik, a resident of Benteji village “

if fighting for myself and my community’s rights makes me a criminal, so be it. I am not afraid of going to jail for my mother, my jungle.

” Cities have already gobbled up their green cover. The rural village people and the Adivasis remains the last bastion between human greed and the last vestiges of life sustaining ecosystems. Paradoxically, their city bred brethren have chosen to stand as mute spectators. It is high time the city dwellers stand in solidarity and take concrete action with the forest dwellers to redefine growth and development. Benedict Anderson, the great scholar of Indonesian nationalism wrote “

no one can be a true nationalist who is incapable of feeling ashamed if her/his state or government commits crimes, including against their own citizens

”. The civil society’s deliberate mutism and aversion of gaze while the already marginalized tribal communities bear the ruthlessness and injustice of the state will come back to haunt the entire civilization when there will be no more green and blue cover of vegetation and water respectively on the earth to sustain life. The deafening silence of the civilized urban society will ultimately lead to a spectacular failure for entire human civilization and life as we know it. At a time, when “

belonging

” to the country is being put to test again and again, protests against the inhumanity of the process and calling the leaders of the nation to safeguard the interests of its citizens will be true nationalism.




 







Sankalpa Satapathy

 is an Assistant Professor at the Institute of Public Health Kalyani, West Bengal

content:
Pour qu'on puisse continuer notre agitation sociale on se lance dans un mois de recherche de fonds.




Le Projet-Evasions c'est un réseau multilingue d'amitiés anarchistes qui existe depuis 2019. Après sept joyeuses années à mener nos petites activités*, le temps est venu pour nous de faire appel à votre soutien.




Par « petites activités » on veut dire : faire des trucs dans lesquels on voit du sens, un potentiel émancipateur, révolutionnaire et des perspectives anarchistes. Par « trucs » on parle de création de plein de contenus (livres, brochures, articles, podcast, capsules audio, stickers, revues, cartes postales, jeux, expositions, affiches), 

d'ateliers et de présentations

, de création d'outil pour se former à l'antirep et d'un gros travail de diffusion. Tout ça dans plein de langues différentes paske, l'a-t'on-dit, on est un projet multilingue à cheval entre plusieurs zones linguistiques.




On crée souvent du contenu qu'on a envie de partager mais aussi des outils dont d'autres personnes peuvent se saisir. La majorité du temps on crée notre contenu nous même et quelques fois on collabore avec des personnes externes. On diffuse toutes les versions papiers à prix libre, chaque personne peut décider librement, en fonction de ses propres capacités, de ce qu'elle peut et veut nous donner en échange. En parallèle, toute les 

versions digitales

 de ce que l'on produit sont disponibles gratuitement sur notre site internet.




L'argent qu'on a est majoritairement utilisé pour payer les impressions. Même si on travaille principalement avec une imprimerie camarade qui nous soutien de ouf, les frais d'impression restent notre dépense principale. En deuxième place se trouvent les frais d'envoi qui augmentent chaque année. Quand on envoie à l'étranger, les frais de poste et de douane sont souvent plus élevés que les frais d'impression de la publication que l'on envoie. À côté de ça, on achète aussi régulièrement des livres et d'autres publications auto-éditée qu'on rediffuse à prix libre. À l'âge d'or de notre trésorerie (désormais revolu), on a plusieurs fois pu soutenir des anarchistes en prison, des projets en quête de thunes et quelques rares fois défrayer un peu de nos voyages et du travail que l'on fait. En dernière position dans nos dépenses se trouve les frais de notre site internet et deux trois bricoles logistiques.




À l'heure où l'on écrit ce texte notre caisse comporte exactement 741 francs suisse et 123 euros et si l'on souhaite la remplir à nouveau c'est qu'on a plusieurs projets qui seront bientôt prêts pour à être envoyé à l'impression. Comme élément de comparaison : l'impression des 1000 exemplaires de 

Illégal élégance

 nous a coûté 3000.- soit 3.- l'exemplaire et l'impression des 4000 livres sur les 

interrogatoires

 nous avait coûté 16'000.- soit 4.- par livre.




Alors on a décidé de faire une petite campagne de dons durant le mois d'octobre. Vous pouvez nous envoyer vos modestes ou conséquentes donations avec la mention « EVASIONS » ici

title: ‘a glimpse of empire wondering at the actions of empire.’
content:
elodieunderglass

:

brehaaorgana

:

elodieunderglass

:

Not to get too real on main, but I live in a part of the UK where USAmerican fighter jets have been flying out in the morning - South, of course - and returning in the evening. It is impossible not to notice them. And myself and my friends and neighbours say, “crikey, off to Iran again,” because. Well, of course the USA doesn’t have the resource to regularly cross the Atlantic just to do that; wars in the Middle East are best fought from bases in the Old World; thus, even Trump maintains a fiction of politeness with The United Kingdom, as everyone knows, for the American airbases that are enshrined as a WW2 courtesy, allowing American access to Europe and the Middle East. 

“Off to Iran,” we comment, looking up - you can’t help but look up - but we don’t know that for sure, of course. It’s not on Flightradar, not on the news; probably a secret, except it’s 

our bloody sky and you can’t help but notice. 

What are they doing? Friends say, with authority; 

they’re fighter jets and bombers

, but I can’t say I know with authority. They leave and come back. Is there a bombing campaign we don’t know about? Do they flatten the sky over Iran, just to show off? There will be a flight path, country to country in a long linked line, whose stories will match up, where we could all work out what they’re doing; but who could follow that thread?

Do Americans know? 

Everyone says they’re going to Iran - they certainly started flying distraction-low over us around then; they’re low-flying, impossible to hide. Are they? They certainly seem to thicken up - tearing apart the sky and frightening the children and setting all the dogs to bark - whenever America rattles a new sabre. But why? Of course there is not official information about why one must tolerate them. British people gather and complain and criticise, especially when they crash horribly through a Teams meeting or a conversation. They cannot quite talk about the planes like British people talk about weather; they’re fighter jets, and fearful, and still British people wonder; 

is it a secret? Is it bad to notice them? Is it polite?

Perhaps it will simply be useful for future historians to know, in  2026, in a corner of England, people looked up and wondered, and worried, and put their heads down again: not knowing what it meant, and not liking it all. 

Today my friend shaded her eyes, the children around us - we have seven between us - going silent and pointing like dogs at the planes. They screamed overhead - the end of the world - 

with friends like these who needs anemones.

(Their shapes are bad, if you don’t know.)

 My friend said, simply, with sincerity, “I hate them so much.”

I was so very glad that she had admitted to having noticed them that I bumped her, affectionately, shoulder to shoulder. 

What a good friend she is! Admitting to the planes! 

Do you know about the planes? There are so many, so loud, so often - going and coming back - 

Idk what is meant by 

“it’s not on the news” and “not knowing what it meant at all…” Because it’s very much on the news and has been for the majority of the year thus far. 

Reuters

 20 March 2026

The guardian

 12 Apr 2026

BBC

 24 July 2026

Air & Space Forces

 magazine 4 September 2026

Your 

Commons Library

 which, and this isn’t me joking, idk if the prime minister who said “On 1 March 2026, the Prime Minister also said that the US could use UK military bases for a “specific and limited defensive purpose”, which he said was to “destroy the [Iranian] missiles at source”. On 20 March the government said that US use of the bases also includes “US defensive operations to degrade the missile sites and capabilities being used to attack ships” in Hormuz. Bases to be used are Diego Garcia (British Indian Ocean Territory/Chagos Archipelago) and RAF Fairford (Gloucestershire).” Is the prime minister you currently have? 

But it’s not a secret when your prime minister said it out loud to everybody? Announced it, even? 

this post is also interesting to me because I think it does make a valid point (some Americans 

don’t

 really *think* about the global impact of our military bases)

 but it’s also like…a glimpse of empire wondering at the actions of empire. As if removed, somehow…? Different somehow? 

You know the UK maintains 145 overseas military installations across 42 different countries, right? At least 60 are directly run by British Armed Forces, 17 of those in Cyprus. Additionally 69 allied countries host British military personnel (including the US). The US has far more overseas installations but the saber rattling empire habits is a learned behavior. 

Why 

does

 Britain have 17 installations in just Cyprus, anyways…? (Ohhh… a former crown colony used to maintain control of the Suez canal and the route to British India? Yet 

*another

* instance of former British colonies tearing themselves apart due to ethnic clashes because they can’t agree on unity versus partition? 

Yeesh.

) 

Anyways. It’s been on the news, it’s not a secret, your politicians have talked about it, it’s on your government websites even. 

I like the phrase “empire wondering at the actions of empire"! I think you’ve cut across the intention of the post and missed a few things, and I’m quite annoyed with you for calling me “British”. This is unfair of me, but it was also unfair of you. 

This post is documentation of impact, told through lived experience in a lyrical way. This isn’t “confusion about the existence of US airbases in the UK” (that’s explained to you, the reader, quite thoroughly in the first paragraph) or “ignorance of the UK’s position” (that’s also. explained. In the post.) This, and the later posts, were about the scale and size of deployment, 

which did not match reporting or agreement. 

The question in the post was not:

 “whoa golly gosh, why are there planes here?”

 It was: 

“Is there a bombing campaign we don’t know about?”

You almost certainly did not know about the size and scale of the deployment; nor did you know the purpose of it. I am actually also American  - don’t worry, you can’t be expected to know that, any more than you’re expected to track the UK’s prime ministers, apparently - and I knew more than you about it, because my house is under the B1s.

You see, in August 2026, the USA was not supposed to be bombing Iran. There wasn’t supposed to be a campaign. The quotes you posted yourself indicated that there would be limited strikes in support of British interests. 

The encyclopaedia Britannica states:

Following about three weeks of military exchanges between the two countries, 

conflict virtually ceased through most of August

, except for a handful of limited drone attacks by Iran on targets in the Gulf Arab states.

“Conflict virtually ceasing in August” is what 

you

 were told. “The USA is allowed to do training exercises from Fairford, and launch attacks protect British interests in the Middle East, and possibly attack hostile missile infrastructure, according to the rules of war, as long as it’s, you know, 

in British interests,

” is the agreement that the UK made with the USA. 

And then I told you, on August 28 2026, about heavy bombers and fighters deploying in 

startling

 numbers to the Middle East.

(Because people didn’t know this - B1s are too big to launch from aircraft carriers.)

You like news stories; here’s a more recent one. On September 2, 2026, this was stated in local news as a 

sharp increase.

Increased sightings of B1 Lancer bombers overhead as US war with Iran escalates

Do you want to know how many B1 Lancers are at Fairford? There are 14 B1 Lancers at Fairford. The article implicitly notes that there were more buzzing around than one might expect from the news. It acknowledges that you hear them coming for miles. It acknowledges that there were a fuckton of them. The article reminds residents not to record or photograph their movements. 

And then today, as I’m sure you followed, it was villagers in Gloucestershire who reported five suspicious men behaving strangely and moving in the direction of the airbase -  

https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/security-increased-us-fairford-air-base-england-2026-09-27/

Iran 

had

 specifically stated that they considered UK airbases hosting USA equipment to be fair game, so people have half-been expecting this. Still, with a small village evacuated overnight, it’s on our minds, you know? 

People who live here are putting together different puzzle pieces than you are. 

We are thinking about schools in Gloucestershire and hospitals in Swindon, and how it was villagers who noticed, and we are thinking perhaps a bit differently than you are about how Iran’s complaints - that the USA is using the UK bases to attack civilian infrastructure - probably feel to people Iran. After all, people living 

here

 know what the planes feel like overhead.

Just like the USA, Iran does not have the ready capability to cross the Atlantic. We are thinking of very specific things when we look at the sky.

The questions in the post were: “do Americans know?” and: “what is 

actually

 happening?” And - although I think you misread the post - despite clearly being well-read, I don’t believe you know at all. You can wave a hand and make a lofty comment like “well, EVERYONE KNOWS they’re bombing Iran and lying about it,” but then who is “everyone knows” and why are you quoting them, and not me?

You will read about it in the news many hours after I see the planes.




‘a glimpse of empire wondering at the actions of empire.’

like… that’s a good thing. I hope we can see that citizens of the imperial core wondering how much harm the empire is doing in their name is a good thing. It may be a well-informed wondering or not, but the wondering how much harm the empire is doing in their name itself is important.

author: anonerror
title: Compañera de la Kasa de la Muntanya detenida por orden de la Audiencia Nacional
content:
Compañera de la Kasa de la Muntanya detenida por orden de la Audiencia Nacional

El 29 de septiembre, nuestra compañera Julia, de Kasa de la Muntanya, sufrió un secuestro por parte de la Policía Nacional, al ser interceptada por policías encapuchados en los alrededores de la Kasa y trasladada a la Verneda en una actuación policial desproporcionada. Se la acusa de delito continuado de daños, obstrucción a la justicia y organización terrorista.

El 30 fue trasladada a Madrid, a la Audiencia Nacional, bajo la amenaza de ingresar en prisión provisional. Ni ella ni la abogada que la asistió han sido debidamente informadas de los hechos concretos que motivaron la detención, mientras se producen dilaciones en el proceso que alargan al máximo los plazos establecidos por la ley.

El caso, bajo secreto de sumario, mantiene en la incertidumbre la situación en la que se encuentra nuestra compañera.

A pesar de todo, por el momento, se encuentra bien física y anímicamente.

Pasó a disposición judicial para que el juez decidiera si queda en libertad, en libertad bajo fianza o ingresa en prisión preventiva a 600 km de su casa.

( Finalmente, el juez ha acordado su puesta en libertad sin fianza, con retirada de pasaporte y la obligación de ir a firmado en los juzgados cada quince días. El abogado Daniel Amelang, miembro de Red Jurídica y que lleva la defensa, ha explicado a este medio que la acusación se deriva de una campaña de acciones contra CaixaBank. "Es muy grave, de hecho, es una salvajada, que se califique como terrorismo unos daños que no son graves, que no ponen en peligro a las personas y que pueden ocurrir en cualquier manifestación. Aunque finalmente se acabe demostrando falsa la acusación", considera Amelang ).

Nosotras estamos preparadas para acompañarla durante todo este proceso y contamos con todo el apoyo que podáis brindarnos.

Desde Kasa de la Muntanya queremos denunciar los abusos del Estado y la represión policial contra cualquier disidencia política en la lucha de los movimientos sociales, con la excusa de la amenaza terrorista. Creemos que esta actuación delirante no es casualidad en un contexto social muy tensionado por la crisis de las condiciones de vida y la creciente movilización en las calles. Este tipo de hechos no son ninguna novedad, sino la respuesta habitual y reiterada del Estado hacia las personas y colectivos que luchan y ponen el cuerpo en defensa de la justicia social. El Estado busca criminalizar e intimidar a toda disidencia política. Con nosotras no lo conseguirán. Seguiremos al lado de nuestra compañera hasta el final, seguiremos en las calles por todo aquello que consideramos justo, cueste lo que cueste, y os animamos también a vosotras a seguir luchando. A la lucha por la justicia social la llaman terrorismo. ¡Pero no nos callarán! La solidaridad, nuestra mejor arma. Atentas a próximas convocatorias.

title: ΒΑΛΚΑΝΙΚΟ ΑΝΑΡΧΙΚΟ ΦΕΣΤΙΒΑΛ ΒΙΒΛΙΟΥ ΣΤΑ ΣΚΟΠΙΑ Συνεισφορά στην επεξεργασία συγκεκριμένων δράσεων, επικεντρώνοντας σε μιλιταρισμό, φασισμό, παλαιστινιακό και διεθνιστική αλληλεγγύη
content:
Συνέντευξη με τον Αρτάν, μέλος της Αναρχικής Συλλογικότητας 

Smokva

 των Σκοπίων, που διοργάνωσε το προ ημερών 18

ο

 Βαλκανικό Αναρχικό Φεστιβάλ Βιβλίου. Διατυπώνει μια πρώτη αποτίμηση, που επικεντρώθηκαν οι συζητήσεις, σε τι συνεισέφερε στα ευρύτερα ζητήματα και κυρίως ποιες αποφασίστηκε να είναι οι άμεσες δράσεις.




>Πώς αποτιμάται το 4ήμερο Βαλκανικό Αναρχικό Φεστιβάλ Βιβλίου στα Σκόπια;




Όπως είχαμε την ευκαιρία να συζητήσουμε, είχαμε μια πολύ ιδιαίτερη εμπειρία αυτού του φεστιβάλ στα Σκόπια. Αποτελεί μια από τις σημαντικές συνεισφορές στην περιοχή.




Τρία ή τέσσερα χρόνια πριν δεν θα είχαμε τέτοια δυνατότητα. Αλλά επειδή στο προηγούμενο ΒΑΒ στη Θεσσαλονίκη που ήμασταν περίπου 20 ακτιβιστές από εδώ γεννήθηκε η ιδέα να διεξαχθεί στα Σκόπια, κάτι που αποτέλεσε κίνητρο για εμάς και αμέσως αρχίσαμε την προετοιμασία του.




Έτσι άρχισε να ενεργοποιείται ένας κόσμος, ιδιαίτερα νεολαίοι που πριν δεν είχαν κάποια εμπλοκή με τα κινήματα. Κάτι που το είδαμε όλοι μας αυτές τις ημέρες με τη συμμετοχή τόσων ανθρώπων από την πόλη, εδώ.




>Σε ποια θέματα επικεντρώθηκαν οι εκδηλώσεις και συζητήσεις;




Ξεκινήσαμε από τοπικά ζητήματα της περιοχής αλλά και ευρύτερα διεθνή ζητήματα, όπως η γενοκτονία στη Γάζα και η διεθνιστική αλληλεγγύη στην Παλαιστίνη, η αντίδραση στον νέο μιλιταρισμό ιδιαίτερα στην Ευρώπη, η καταπίεση και καταστολή κα. Έτσι είχαμε αρκετές συζητήσεις πάνω σε αυτά τα θέματα και πώς θα οργανώσουμε την αντίστασή μας.




Επίσης, είχαμε συζητήσεις για τις πολιτικές, τους τρόπους οργάνωσης και τις κινητοποιήσεις ενάντια στον φασισμό στα Βαλκάνια, αλλά και στην Ευρώπη, και θα συνεχιστεί η συζήτηση μέχρι το επόμενο ΒΑΒ. Κάτι που αποτέλεσε συνεισφορά των συντρόφων που ήρθαν από ευρωπαϊκές χώρες, να μην περιοριστούμε στα Βαλκάνια αλλά ευρύτερα διεθνώς.




Άλλωστε τα Βαλκάνια σήμερα αποτελούν σημαντικό σημείο επικέντρωσης των αναρχικών διεθνώς. Και αυτό είναι ένα στοίχημα το πως μια βαλκανική οργάνωση μπορεί να συνεισφέρει ευρύτερα, κάτι που αναγνωρίζεται. Ήταν πρόκληση 14 χρόνια μετά την προηγούμενη διοργάνωση εδώ στα Σκόπια.




>Ποια μπορούμε να πούμε ότι είναι το σημαντικότερο χαρακτηριστικό αυτού του ΒΑΒ;




Νομίζω ένα από τα σημαντικότερα ήταν η μεγάλη συμμετοχή στις συνελεύσεις πάνω σε ζητήματα δράσης. Δεν μείναμε μόνο στο επίπεδο της κατάθεσης πολιτικών ιδεών αλλά στην επεξεργασία συγκεκριμένων βημάτων δράσης και όχι μόνο στα Βαλκάνια. Έτσι ελήφθησαν 3 συγκεκριμένες αποφάσεις.




Μια περιφερειακή και διεθνής αντιμιλιταριστική οργάνωση και μία ημέρα διεθνούς δράσης κατά του μιλιταρισμού. Όπως επίσης συζητήσαμε και για τον τόπο διοργάνωσης του επόμενου ΒΑΒ που θα καταληχθεί στον επόμενο μήνα.
